req.title: 404 on unknown task id
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 404 and detail 'Task not found' when the id does not exist.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-009 requires HTTP 404 with a detail message when GET /tasks/{task_id} is called with a non-existent ID. The test suite covers: (1) a positive case confirming a known ID returns 200 with correct payload (EP — validates the happy path and ensures the 404 branch is not always taken); (2) a primary negative case using a clearly non-existent ID (99999) confirming exact 404 status and exact detail string (NEG + constant-mutation); (3) a boundary case using task_id=21 (one above the highest seeded ID of 20) to confirm 404 at the boundary (BVA + off-by-one mutation); (4) a boundary case using task_id=0 (below the minimum valid seeded ID of 1) to confirm 404 (BVA); (5) a decision-table case confirming that a deleted task also yields 404, exercising the state where the record existed then was removed (STC/DT). Each test asserts the exact status code integer and the exact detail substring to kill status-code constant mutations and string-content mutations.

tests.name: test_get_existing_task_returns_200
preconditions: Database is seeded with 20 tasks; task id=1 exists with title='Read chapter 5'
expected: Response JSON contains id=1 and title='Read chapter 5' and completed=true
trace: R-TASK-009 — validates the non-error partition so the 404 branch is not trivially always-true
tests.executable:
import os, sys
os.environ.setdefault('DATABASE_URL', 'sqlite://')
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.database import Base, get_db
from app.main import app
from app import models
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

engine = create_engine('sqlite://', connect_args={'check_same_thread': False})
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
TestingSession = sessionmaker(bind=engine)

def override_get_db():
    db = TestingSession()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
client = TestClient(app)

db = TestingSession()
task = models.Task(id=1, title='Read chapter 5', description='Signal pulse ember', completed=True)
db.add(task)
db.commit()
db.close()

def test_get_existing_task_returns_200():
    r = client.get('/tasks/1')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body['id'] == 1
    assert body['title'] == 'Read chapter 5'
    assert body['completed'] is True

test_get_existing_task_returns_200()
app.dependency_overrides.clear()

Send GET /tasks/5 to attempt retrieval of the now-deleted task
